letter.subject: EU261 compensation claim - flight FR8820 on 2026-10-25
letter.body:
Dear Ryanair Customer Relations,

We act on behalf of our client regarding flight FR8820 on 2026-10-25 from Barcelona (BCN) to Dublin (DUB), which was operated, but the passenger was denied boarding against their will.

Under Regulation (EC) No 261/2004, Articles 5, 7 and the case law of the Court of Justice of the EU, the passenger is entitled to compensation of EUR 250 for this denied boarding. The flight distance is 1,485 km.

Based on the information available to us, no extraordinary circumstances apply.

Please pay EUR 250 within 14 days of this letter and send your reply to our claims team.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Team
